projected_costs._premium_basis: No line has an unapplied Multi-AZ uplift: the RDS rate is baked_in Multi-AZ; Elastic Beanstalk's EC2 has no AZ-driven rate and its ALB is intrinsic. Premium equals Balanced, 210.
projected_costs._optimized_basis: Eligible subtotal 187 = Elastic Beanstalk EC2 component 92 (of 115: EC2 92 + ALB 16 + LCU 6 + EBS 1) x 0.30 compute_savings_plan -> 28, plus RDS 95 x 0.20 database_savings_plan_provisioned -> 19; ineligible 23 unchanged; 210 - 47 = 163. Rates from knowledge/estimate/estimate-defaults.json optimized_tier_discounts.

would_flip_if: A confirmed always-on traffic pattern would raise the AWS compute estimate materially.

optimization_opportunities.prerequisite: Establish an AWS compute usage baseline before committing
optimization_opportunities.description: Heroku dyno billing is flat-rate per dyno type; the Beanstalk EC2 usage pattern may differ. Covers the EC2 component (92 of the 115 Elastic Beanstalk line); the ALB, LCU and EBS components are not eligible.

optimization_opportunities.timing: immediately post-migration or after instance right-sizing
optimization_opportunities.prerequisite: Confirm the db.t4g.medium Multi-AZ instance class before committing
optimization_opportunities.description: Heroku Postgres runs 24/7 with predictable usage. Database Savings Plans keep the flexibility to change instance class post-migration. Mutually exclusive with RDS Reserved Instances on the same workload.
